untertitel: Present simple questions: *Do* you get up early at the weekend?

grammatik.regel: Questions in the present simple start with _Do_ (I, you, we, they) or _Does_ (he, she, it, one person). The main verb stays in the base form, with no -s: _Does_ Tom *get up* early? Short answers: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

redemittel.p2: Yes, I do. I get up at seven.

soGehts: Cut page 2 in half. Partner A and Partner B have different bingo squares.
On your own: Put the words in order and write three questions.
In pairs: A asks about a square. If B says "yes", A ticks "yes". Then B asks.
The first player with three "yes" answers in a row (across, down or diagonally) shouts "Bingo!".
Keep playing: who has more "yes" answers at the end?

hinweise: Start with Do. The verb stays in the base form: Do you watch …? (not watches).
Answer: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Add at the weekend, on Sundays or in the evening if you like.

schritte.anweisung: On your own: Put the words in order. Write the question.
